QUOTE: "`ExternalBridge::run_async_ask` (`:1158`) | detached async-ask worker" and "`run_async_ask` uses a detached `std::thread` that captures `this`. The index shows no join or ownership record for it. Whether the bridge outlives it in shutdown is not shown."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as a detached thread with no join or ownership record, and it flags the lifetime risk. It never says it is the only detached thread, but the other threads are described as joined or reaped.
